---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for ClaudeCode Writer
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves
What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution
How should this feature work? Be as detailed as possible.

## Alternative Solutions
Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## Use Case
Describe your specific use case for this feature.

## Examples
Show examples of:
- How you would use this feature
- Similar features in other tools
- Mock-up of the command/workflow

## Additional Context
Any other context, screenshots, or examples.

## Would You Like to Contribute?
- [ ] I'm willing to implement this feature
- [ ] I need help implementing this
- [ ] I can test this feature

## Type of Feature
- [ ] New skill
- [ ] New hook
- [ ] New command
- [ ] New workflow
- [ ] Enhancement to existing feature
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] Other (please describe)
